proposal.name: Keep library indexes and bytes consistent

plan.name: Keep library indexes and bytes consistent
plan.summary: Change only the shared library route so a missing index (ENOENT) means an empty library, while other read failures and malformed JSON fail the request with a 5xx without changing the published index or blobs. POST must write the new blob and atomically publish the new index before removing replaced or trimmed blobs; DELETE must publish the index without the selected item, or an empty index for delete-all, before removing blobs. Keep the write lock, write-then-rename publication, upsert by kind and name, 60-item cap, newest-first listing, metadata validation and existing response contracts, including propagation of storage failures; failed cleanup may leave unlisted blobs but must never undo publication or remove bytes still listed. Acceptance tests exercise the route with filesystem failures and inspect persisted state between operations, including read-error recovery and concurrent saves; no documentation change is required because the documented library behavior stays the same.

tests.name: List fails safely on an unreadable index
tests.says: Only ENOENT means an empty list; other read errors and malformed JSON fail without changing the index or blobs.
tests.selector: shared library index safety rejects unreadable and corrupt indexes when listing

tests.name: Save fails safely and the write lock recovers
tests.says: A save cannot replace an unreadable or corrupt index with a new library; subsequent concurrent saves still preserve all items.
tests.selector: shared library index safety rejects unreadable and corrupt indexes when saving and recovers the write lock

tests.name: Single delete fails safely on an unreadable index
tests.says: Deleting one item fails without modifying any stored data if the index cannot be read or parsed.
tests.selector: shared library index safety rejects unreadable and corrupt indexes when deleting one item

tests.name: Delete-all fails safely on an unreadable index
tests.says: Delete-all cannot turn an unreadable or corrupt index into an empty library.
tests.selector: shared library index safety rejects unreadable and corrupt indexes when deleting all items

tests.name: Upsert publishes before retiring old bytes
tests.says: An upsert replaces only matching kind and name, keeps other items and response shapes, and leaves every listed blob readable at every filesystem boundary.
tests.selector: shared library index safety publishes an upsert before removing replaced blobs

tests.name: Trimming publishes before retiring old bytes
tests.says: Saving item 61 keeps the new item and the newest 59 existing items, with no listed item losing bytes before publication.
tests.selector: shared library index safety publishes the capped newest-first library before removing trimmed blobs

tests.name: Failed save publication preserves old bytes
tests.says: Directory, new-blob write, temporary-index write and rename failures leave the old published index and all of its blobs intact for replacement and trimming saves.
tests.selector: shared library index safety preserves the old library when a save cannot publish

tests.name: Save cleanup failure leaves only an orphan
tests.says: A failed removal after an upsert or trim propagates the storage failure but leaves the new item published and the obsolete bytes unlisted.
tests.selector: shared library index safety keeps the new index published when save cleanup fails

tests.name: Delete publishes before removing bytes
tests.says: Single delete and delete-all publish their new index before cleanup, retain their success responses, and keep the existing no-op behavior for an unknown id.
tests.selector: shared library index safety publishes deletions before removing any listed bytes

tests.name: Failed delete publication preserves old bytes
tests.says: Directory, temporary-index write and rename failures during single delete or delete-all preserve every originally indexed blob.
tests.selector: shared library index safety preserves the old library when a deletion cannot publish

tests.name: Delete cleanup failure cannot leave dangling entries
tests.says: Removal failures, including after one successful removal during delete-all, leave the selected entries absent from the published index and all remaining listed bytes intact.
tests.selector: shared library index safety keeps deletions published when cleanup fails partway through

usage.summary: Created `plan.json` and 11 acceptance tests covering safe index reads and publishing index changes before blob cleanup. The check passed: every acceptance test fails on the base code as required, and `repo/` remains unchanged.
